DSR adjusts the Sharpe for skew/kurtosis and the number of configurations tested; p > 0.95 indicates that the Sharpe is statistically superior to the maximum expected under H0 of zero skill. PBO < 0.20 indicates low probability of overfitting (López de Prado 2016).
